attempts.text:
**The spine starts with `rihC`.** Columns 0 to 7, `rihC` to `rpsT`, are carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 0.2% of calls. The model names 99 to 100% of them, and no column here hesitates more than 0.18 bits.

**The first fork is at column 8**, a fimbrial family protein, in a region of plasticity in 23% of calls: the model names 51% and hesitates 1.96 bits, the most hesitant column of the window. Then columns 9 to 11, `nhaR` to `mokC`, persistent, carried by 96%, in a region of plasticity in 23 to 31% of calls; the model names 85 to 91%, hesitating most at `mokC`, 0.59 bits. Column 12, a transposase, is a fork in a region of plasticity in 30% of calls.

**A long persistent stretch runs from `dnaJ` to `lplA`**, columns 13 to 44, carried by 91 to 96%, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 18% of calls, with [[threonine biosynthesis]] and [[chaperone protein folding]] among its genes. The model names 92 to 99%, hesitating most at `ytjB`, 0.35 bits. Column 45, a sigma factor-like helix-turn-helix, is a fork; then columns 46 to 56, `deoD` to `prfC`, persistent, with [[deoxyribonucleoside catabolism]], named 91 to 99%.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns**, 57 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 6 to 54% of calls. The model names 73 to 96%, fewest at column 64, 73%, and hesitates most at `lgoT`, 0.70 bits. A branch of 5 families, `hpaR` to a 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate family, runs through columns 75 to 79, carried by 11 to 22%, all shell, [[homoprotocatechuate degradation]]. The window ends at column 79, a BrnT family toxin, in 17% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 1.09 against 0.19 bits, and names fewer genes, 74% against 96%. Persistent calls are named 98% at 0.13 bits; shell calls 68% at 1.05 bits; cloud calls 15% at 3.68 bits.

label: rihC
facts:
WINDOW: the rihC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rihC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,684 to 3,763 from dnaA. Read in 529 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rihC once); 42,320 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,215 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 5,853 calls, named 68%, 1.05 bits; cloud 252 calls, named 15%, 3.68 bits. Outside an RGP 38,011 calls, named 96%, 0.19 bits; inside an RGP 4,309 calls, named 74%, 1.09 bits. Columns: 54 spine, 11 fork, 15 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.09 against 0.19 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 96%); 4,309 of the 42,320 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 8 ("fimbrial family protein") 1.96 bits, RGP 23%; column 73 (lgoT) 0.70 bits, RGP 37%; column 74 (tsr) 0.64 bits, RGP 40%. The 2 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.47 bits on average; the other 78 columns: named 93%, 0.27 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 12 (fork), RGP 30%; the least: columns 0-7 (spine), RGP 0-0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-7 (8 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0-0.2%. Genes: rihC, ispH, fkpB, lspA, ileS, ribF, yaaY "DUF2575 family protein", rpsT. named 99-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 1 (ispH), named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 6 (yaaY)).
2. column 8 fork: RGP 23%. named 51%; 1.96 bits.
   8: "fimbrial family protein" S 52%; also espX1 S 29%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 28%
3. columns 9-11 (3 columns) spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 23-31%. Genes: nhaR, nhaA "Na+/H+ antiporter NhaA", mokC. named 85-91% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 11 (mokC), named 85%, 0.59 bits.
4. column 12 fork: RGP 30%. named 68%; 0.58 bits.
   12: "transposase" S 45%; also "outer membrane protein OmpK" S 18%
5. columns 13-44 (32 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-18%. Genes: dnaJ, dnaK "molecular chaperone DnaK", yaaI "DUF2541 family protein", msyB, satP, mog, tal, yaaJ "alanine:cation symporter family pro…", yaaA "peroxide stress protein YaaA", yaaX "DUF2502 domain-containing protein", thrC, thrB, thrA, thrL "thr operon leader peptide", yjtD "TrmH family RNA methyltransferase", yjjY "protein YjjY", arcA, creD, creC "two-component system sensor histidi…", creB, creA, robA, gpmB, yjjX "inosine/xanthosine triphosphatase", trpR, sltY, ettA, nadR, radA, serB, ytjB "YtjB family periplasmic protein", lplA. named 92-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 43 (ytjB), named 92%, 0.35 bits.
6. column 45 fork: RGP 9%. named 89%; 0.44 bits.
   45: "sigma factor-like helix-turn-helix DNA-…" S 58%; also yjjJ S 16%
7. columns 46-56 (11 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 1-9%. Genes: deoD, deoB, deoA "thymidine phosphorylase", deoC, yjjI "glycyl radical enzyme domain-contai…", yjjW "4Fe-4S cluster-binding domain-conta…", yjjV "metal-dependent hydrolase", yjjU "patatin-like phospholipase family p…", ytjA "DUF1328 domain-containing protein", osmY, prfC. named 91-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 46 (deoD), named 91%; most hesitant at column 48 (deoA), 0.36 bits.
8. columns 57-79 (23 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 6-54%. named 73-96% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 64, named 73%; most hesitant at column 73, 0.70 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 75-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-22%, all S; the branch's families: hpaR, hpaG, hpaE, hpaD, "5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate Delta…"
   57 fork: yjjG P 83% "pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase"; also "DinI-like family protein" S 12%
   columns 58-65 variable, share 78-83%, all P: rimI 83%, holD 83%, rsmC 83%, yjjZ "DUF1435 family protein" 82%, fhuF 82%, bglJ 78%, yjjQ "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…" 78%, yjjP "threonine/serine ThrE exporter fami…" 82%
   66 fork: yjjB P 82% "threonine/serine exporter"; also "C40 family peptidase" S 10%
   67 fork: dnaT P 81% "DnaT-like ssDNA-binding domain-cont…"; also "phage minor tail protein L" S 10%
   columns 68-74 variable, share 58-81%, 5 P, 2 S: dnaC 81%, yjjA "DUF2501 domain-containing protein Y…" 80%, opgB 79%, lgoD "L-galactonate oxidoreductase" 76%, lgoR 68%, lgoT 58%, tsr 66%
   75 fork: btsT P 36%
   76 fork: yjiX P 34% "YbdD/YjiX family protein"; also "cation:proton antiporter" S 11%
   77 fork: yjiA P 30% "GTPase"; also "TRAP transporter substrate-binding prot…" S 11%
   78 fork: "BrnA antitoxin family protein" S 26%; also "TRAP transporter small permease subunit" S 11%
   79 fork: "BrnT family toxin" S 17%; also "TRAP transporter large permease" S 11%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): thrC threonine synthase; thrB homoserine kinase; creD cell envelope integrity protein CreD; creB winged helix-turn-helix domain-containi…; deoB phosphopentomutase; deoC deoxyribose-phosphate aldolase; dnaT DnaT-like ssDNA-binding domain-containi…; dnaC DNA replication protein DnaC; lgoT MFS transporter; yjjJ type II toxin-antitoxin system HipA fam…; hpaR homoprotocatechuate degradation operon…; hpaG fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase family pr…; hpaE aldehyde dehydrogenase family protein; hpaD 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate 2,3-dioxygen…
